title: Seeded counter run
statement: Let $M_V,M_I,M_P$ be finite-state Boolean Turing machines, let $x$ be a Boolean word, let $p$ be one of the $|x|+2$ input-head positions, and let $Q\in\mathbb N$. Start the specified host machine in its counter phase with the input head at $p$, a word of $Q$ true bits on the designated word tape, and all other work-tape cells blank. After $(2Q+3)+(2Q+3)$ steps, its configuration is exactly the configuration with the input head still at $p$, a word of $Q$ false bits on that tape, a word of $Q$ true bits on the designated buffer tape, and all other work-tape cells blank, with the host in its rewind-start state. At every time up to and including that time, every work-tape head is at distance at most $Q+1$ from the origin.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a valid input-head position among the $|x|+2$ positions
